purpose: Teach: 椎/蕾/唾/皺/両端/左折/８つ/スギ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、椎茸スープを召し上がってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer was having shiitake soup, Aoi noticed.
lines.style: Gentle, observational. Warm recounting of a small detail. Soft voice, as if sharing a quiet memory with someone you trust.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、店先の桜の蕾を眺めてらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She was gazing at the cherry buds outside the shop, Aoi said.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. A slight pause before speaking, like picturing the scene. Lingering on the image with quiet appreciation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ふと唾を飲んで、ケーキを我慢されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She swallowed hard and held back from ordering cake, poor thing.
lines.style: Gentle wryness with underneath kindness. Light, knowing tone—not mocking, but recognising the small restraint. A hint of sympathy in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、シャツの皺を気にされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She kept fussing with the wrinkles in her shirt.
lines.style: Observant, tender. Not judgmental—noticing the small nervous gesture with the care of someone who sees people clearly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、カウンターの両端のスツールがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Apparently she loves sitting at the ends of the counter where the stools are.
lines.style: Warm discovery in the voice. Finding something small but real about someone. Slight lift—this is a detail that matters.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お店から左折された所のお花屋さんを尋ねてらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She asked about the flower shop, the one just past the left turn from here.
lines.style: Conversational, helpful recall. Placing the detail carefully, like describing something to someone you're helping navigate.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お菓子の詰め合わせを８つご注文だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She ordered eight boxes of assorted sweets.
lines.style: Simple statement with warmth underneath. The precision of the number said plainly, without emphasis. Just the fact of it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、スギ花粉症のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She was telling us about her cedar pollen allergies.
lines.style: Closing observation with quiet affection. Slight fade at the end—the intimacy of someone sharing their small troubles. Warm and settling.
